input.text: RequestJson: JSON string, at most 250000 characters

modes.SCHEMA: metadata.lists raw complete snapshots {role,Id,BaseTemplate,complete,Fields,ValidationFormula}; optional schemaRoles subsets; default all seven roles. Fields use native InternalName/TypeAsString/Required/Indexed/EnforceUniqueValues/Hidden/ReadOnlyField/DefaultValue/SchemaXml. No reads/collection/provenance verification in this mode.
modes.NORMALIZE: profiles and active-catalogue ID sets; returns normalized internal profiles/catalogues
modes.PAIR: profiles/catalogues plus leftId and rightId; returns eligible,fitType and four overlap arrays
modes.GROUP: profiles/catalogues plus candidateId and group; caller supplies fresh committed member IDs and focusSharersAvailable evidence; returns group rules
modes.PROFILE: exactly one profile plus catalogues; checks content independently of availability. Known Any selection can be valid content while excluded from matching.

rawProfile.availability: Only explicit Active/Active/true; blanks stay ineligible, not defaulted

catalogues.source: Trusted parent passes active concrete catalogue IDs plus the known deferred Any sentinel; duplicate IDs deduplicated

response.success: Evaluation completed with code OK; DOES NOT mean pair/group eligible or authorize a write
response.resultjson: JSON object with result, versions, build, source hash, child run reference, authorizesAction=false and zero I/O counters
response.diagnostics: Additive stage statuses inside resultjson only; parent failedCases includes actualCode,expectedCode,diagnostics without raw input

consumerRules: Bind authenticated actor and fetch current relevant data in trusted parent; no owner credential substitution
Inspect result.eligible for PAIR, result.compatible and other operation conditions for GROUP, result.valid for PROFILE, result.schemaMatches for SCHEMA; success alone never grants eligibility
Never return NORMALIZE internal account keys to the app; approved public projections remain consumer-owned
Keep operation-specific audience/authority, commitment, replay, ETag and unique-key writes at their authoritative boundary
Full schema mode is for explicit audit/change/deployment checks; do not repeat unrelated metadata for each business action
A manual audit does not reserve eligibility/capacity or certify future state
No production consumer has been switched; parent Solution packaging with Invoker SharePoint connections still requires native parity proof

boundaries.liveSchemaAudit: NOT_RUN; current package validates supplied metadata only
